nodes.label: SyncNet Summary Bar Charts
nodes.content: Two grouped bar charts with error bars comparing natural_raw vs tts_raw on Sync-C (↑better, scores ~5.6 vs ~6.8) and Sync-D (↓better, scores ~8.2 vs ~6.8). TTS outperforms natural speech on both metrics: higher Sync-C confidence and lower Sync-D distance. Error bars show moderate variability with non-overlapping intervals suggesting statistically significant differences. Demonstrates that TTS can achieve better audio-visual synchronization than natural recordings in the SyncNet evaluation framework.
